Now `p-[7px]` + border = 62 with both on the frame's 8, at every width (13006:158985 at 375 declares the same box). Now `pb-[5px]`, 28 / 26 / 24. The oracle's band case summed the padding and never the border, so it read green against the 64 box; it now counts the border, and a new rail case pins 24/26/28. Both mutation-tested: `p-2` back gives "expected 9 to be 8", `pb-1.5` back gives "expected 25 to be 24", both restored; AdjustTrenchSettings.figma.test.tsx 44/44 and 14 sibling suites 119/119. The test file is the shell lane's by prefix and was edited with its agreement. PARTIAL FOR TWO ITEMS, neither a missed number. (a) This BASE board draws no Text size group; the panel draws it on every tab, taken from the three "with text size ALT" Layout cuts (13006:158664 / :323216 / :194830), so Display settings stands 350 against the board's 250 (16 gap + 16 label + 8 + 60). Base-governs-over-ALT would remove a working control (TokenRow reads textSize) that three done rows pin, so it is listed for Casey and not removed. (b) The board's description reads "Select margin settings for this trade." on a display-settings panel with no margin control; the file prints "Choose how the Discover table renders each token." rather than a label for a function this panel does not have.
